Unleash TallyPrime with a client-server architecture

TallyPrime Server adds powerful data server capabilities on top of your Gold licence. Its server-based data architecture gives you greater concurrency, controlled access and advanced monitoring.

It is an enterprise-class product built to help fast-growing medium and large businesses work more efficiently.

Key benefits

Why growing teams move their data to a server.

⚡

High concurrency

Work without friction

Many users can load companies, enter transactions, export, print and import data, and take backups at the same time, without waiting on each other. Everyone works on the same data, so it stays real-time, consistent and accurate.

🔐

Secured by design

Controlled access to data files

Data files are managed by the server, so their location is never exposed. Users only need the name of the data server to work in TallyPrime. Backup and restore are controlled by server-level permissions for authorised users only.

🛡️

High reliability

Business-wide availability

Keep recording transactions or viewing reports while a backup runs. A problem on one user's computer does not affect anyone else, so work carries on with no downtime and business performance holds steady.

📈

Business process optimization

See and manage usage

Monitoring lets authorised users see who is logged in and what is in progress, track activity, free up licences and disconnect users when needed. It helps you tune how your team uses the system.
